hermite.source_domain: literal integer dense or sparse matrices
hermite.completeness: V and V_inverse are integer matrices and both inverse identities are independently checked; H satisfies canonical column Hermite pivots and residues.
hermite.return_contract: Ordinary HNF is mutable dense; decomposition preserves each built-in dense/sparse mutable/immutable source class.
hermite.explicitly_unsupported: Modular determinant hints D other than None; nonliteral integer sources; values outside the bounded envelope.
